name: Grey-box mechanism room
notes: The wiring of the grey-box mechanism room (scene mechanism-room, mw-e03.18): the lever by the north doorway raises and lowers the portcullis onto the corridor; the button by the east doorway slides the stone door open for six seconds, then it closes again; the floor crank lifts the trapdoor while it is turned to any position but the first. Binding names are the scene's spawn ids.
